# ALSflow

> ALSflow is a Czech studio with three lines of work: AI assistants for small businesses, hand-written websites, and small custom software (admin panels, integrations, internal tools). It deploys and fully manages AI assistants for small businesses — handling customer emails, appointment booking, reminders, and repeat-booking follow-ups. The client pays a fixed monthly fee and never touches the infrastructure. Operated by Retail Shops s.r.o. (IČO 02512556), Czech Republic.

## What ALSflow does

ALSflow builds and manages three products for Czech small businesses:

- **E-mailové odpovědi (AI Email Replies)** — AI reads and answers customer emails in Czech, in the client's own tone, via Gmail or any existing mailbox. Includes 1,500 emails and a monthly activity report. 2,500 CZK/month.
- **Rezervace & Připomínky (Bookings & Reminders)** — 24/7 booking via WhatsApp or the client's website, automatic appointment confirmations, day-before reminders, and an FAQ bot for prices and availability. Includes 750 bookings. 4,500 CZK/month.
- **Zpětná vazba & Opakované rezervace (Feedback & Repeat Bookings)** — automatic post-visit message, feedback collection, and a well-timed repeat-booking offer, via WhatsApp or email. Unlimited messages. 2,500 CZK/month.
- **Bundle** — all three services together: 7,500 CZK/month.
- **Na míru (Custom)** — custom-built automation (multi-channel, system integrations, full digital reception), priced per project.

## Websites and custom software

- **Tvorba webu (Websites)** — https://alsflow.cz/tvorba-webu — hand-written HTML/CSS/JS sites with no CMS, no plugins, no build step and no cookie banner (fonts are self-hosted, nothing is loaded from third-party servers). Hosted on Vercel with Cloudflare DNS. Contrast is verified against WCAG 2.2 AA before launch. Includes design, copywriting, deployment, domain setup and ongoing maintenance. Fixed price per site plus a monthly maintenance fee; quoted after an initial call. Built so far: gen1.cz (political movement GEN), sekelovaznalec.sk (Slovak expert witness in construction), alsflow.cz.
- **Vývoj softwaru (Custom software)** — https://alsflow.cz/vyvoj-softwaru — small custom tools deployable in weeks: admin panels over the client's own data, integrations between systems that do not talk to each other, automation replacing manual spreadsheet work, and reporting. Built alongside existing systems via API rather than by migrating them. Fixed price for an agreed scope plus a monthly fee for running it. Source code, accounts and documentation belong to the client; data runs in the EU under an Art. 28 GDPR processing agreement.

Does NOT do: e-shops, mobile apps for the App Store or Google Play, systems for hundreds of thousands of users, or taking over undocumented legacy projects.

One-time setup: 8,000–10,000 CZK, live within 3 working days. Monthly billing, no long-term contract, cancel anytime.

## Who ALSflow serves

Primary: appointment-based local businesses in Prague and major Czech cities (Brno, Ostrava, Plzeň, Liberec) — physiotherapists, hair and beauty salons, veterinary clinics, dentists, wellness studios.

Secondary: freelancers and small firms (2–10 people) with high administrative burden.

Shared characteristic: the owner wears many hats, has limited time, is not technical, and loses bookings to missed calls or slow email replies.

## Why ALSflow

- Cheaper than hiring a receptionist (15,000–25,000 CZK/month)
- Fully managed — the client never touches the system
- Czech language, Prague-based, personal service from the founder
- Available 24/7
- Works with existing tools (Gmail, WhatsApp, existing website) — no app install required
